_source: https://www.zerobounce.net/docs/email-validation-api-quickstart/v2-validate-emails, fetched 2026-10-04. 'key_or_credits' is the documented error body ({"error":"Invalid API Key or your account ran out of credits"}). The documentation does not state the HTTP status that accompanies it, so tests exercise it with 200, 400 and 401. UNVERIFIED: the other error texts are plausible wordings, not recorded provider output. '{KEY}' is replaced with the test's sentinel key.

key_or_credits.error: Invalid API Key or your account ran out of credits

credits_only.error: Your account ran out of credits

echoes_key.error: Invalid API Key {KEY} or your account ran out of credits
